WAO is seeking an Architect / Designer to join our team on a freelance basis and help us conceptualize, design, draw, and construct the built environment around us. We are a NYC based studio that works in the public realm, where people live, work, and play. Our design philosophy centers on finding solutions in unexpected opportunities, challenging established paradigms and inspiring new conversations about our role on the planet.
We have a range of projects from concept to construction in New York and Florida. The person joining our team will be working remotely and must be able to manage tasks independently on their personal computer/programs. Being located in/near NYC is an advantage but not a requirement. The role would start at 20 hrs/week and could increase if the candidate has the capacity. Hours are flexible, but the candidate should be available for occasional virtual meetings during the day.
Details:
Have experience with drafting construction documents in residential design
Have experience in construction administration in residential design
Revit, ACAD, Rhino, and Adobe
An education in architecture with 10 years of professional experience
We are looking for a creative, motivated, expedient, and detail oriented person. A unique rendering ability would be an advantage. Salary will be based on an hourly rate and commensurate with experience. We will not be able to accommodate visa requests.
If interested, please send a cover letter about yourself and your interest in the position, along with a CV and portfolio (one pdf 10mb). We’d be happy to hear from you.
